descriptions.notStarted: Tsuri, the gregarious fish merchant, claims to have knowledge of the way to awaken the Zakum Armor's dormant power. I can't imagine this armor at its full strength. Such power!
descriptions.inProgress: According to Tsuri, in order to reawaken the dormant power, I'll have to eliminate #b20 Maladies#k and #b20 Wild Kargo's#k within the time limit. nnNo. of Maladies Left: #r#a80131##knNo. of Wild Kargos Left : #r#a80132##k
descriptions.completed: I tried on the Zakum Armor that has been reawaken by Tsuri. I can literally feel the armor's strength, coursing through my veins...as if the fearsome power of Zakum is mine to wield and control...I feel invincible wearing this. This is awesome!
